data: In the rightmost figure, what is the lowest identification rate value reached by the black line?

The question asks for the lowest identification rate value reached by the black line in the rightmost figure. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the evolution of the identification rate as a function of α and β, when the first and second eigenresiduals (µ1(n) and µ2(n)) are combined according to Equations (5) and (6). The black line represents one of these combinations.

Looking at the rightmost figure, the black line starts at approximately 40% on the y-axis and increases steadily until it reaches its maximum value. The lowest identification rate value reached by the black line is around 40%.
